payload.title: From H100 to B200: GPGPU and LLM Scaling Deep Analysis
payload.summary: A comprehensive analysis of GPU microarchitecture, cluster networking, collective communication, and distributed training scaling strategies based on the Google DeepMind report "How to Scale Your Model."

sections.heading: 1. Introduction: GPGPU Evolution and AI Infrastructure
sections.gist: In the deep learning era, GPUs have evolved into GPGPUs (General-Purpose GPUs) focused on parallel computation.

sections.heading: 2. Chip Architecture: The GPU Microworld
sections.gist: Unlike TPUs (systolic arrays with SIMD), GPUs emphasize flexibility and multi-threaded parallelism.

sections.heading: 3. Networking: Foundation for Cluster Scaling
sections.gist: Within a node (typically 8 GPUs), NVLink provides high-speed interconnect via NVSwitch for all-to-all connectivity.

sections.heading: 5. Scaling Strategies
sections.gist: The golden rule: **compute time must exceed communication time** (Roofline principle).

sections.heading: 6. GB200 NVL72: Scale-Up Renaissance
sections.gist: 72 GPUs across 9 trays, each containing 8 GB200 Superchips + 4 NVSwitch 5.0.

sections.heading: 7. Communication Wall Challenge
sections.gist: GPU compute growth far outpaces bandwidth growth: - Compute: A100 312 → B200 2,250 TFLOPS (7.2x) - Intra-node BW: A100 300 → B200 900 GB/s (3x only) - Inter-node BW: stagnant at 400 GB/s
